title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) für Wärmecontracting
description: Wer wir sind Kola NetZero bringt Eigentümer von Mehrfamilienhäusern mit einem führenden Anbieter für Wärmecontracting zusammen: Der Eigentümer bekommt eine neue, klimafreundliche Heizzentrale ohne eigene Investition, der Anbieter betreibt sie 15 Jahre lang, und wir begleiten den Weg von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Unterschrift. Hinter Kola NetZero steht die Kola Invest GmbH, ein Hamburger Family Office mit Fokus auf Wohnimmobilien. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit großem Ziel: mehrere tausend Wohneinheiten pro Monat in die Wärmewende zu bringen. Dafür bauen wir gerade das Backoffice auf, das aus eingereichten Objekten vertragsreife Projekte macht. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und prägst, wie wir arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den Weg eines Objekts vom Eingang bis zur Freigabe durch den Anbieter. Konkret: Pipeline steuern: 50 bis 100 Objekte gleichzeitig im Prozess halten. Du weißt jederzeit, welches Objekt in welcher Phase steckt, was blockiert und was als Nächstes dran ist, und berichtest das wöchentlich an die Geschäftsführung. Objekteingang prüfen: Energieausweise, Heizkostenabrechnungen, Gasrechnungen und Objektlisten der Eigentümer sichten, Daten in unsere Portfolioliste übertragen und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen. Technischen Fit bewerten: Zentral oder dezentral, Energieträger, Kesselalter, Anzahl Wohneinheiten, Warmwasserbereitung. Du entscheidest mit, welche Objekte an den Anbieter gehen und welche nicht. Vergleichsrechnungen erstellen: Kosten heute gegen Kosten mit Contracting über 15 Jahre (Brennstoff, CO2-Preis, Wartung, Investition) mit unseren Tools aufbereiten und dem Eigentümer erklären können. Beteiligte koordinieren: Eigentümer, Hausverwaltung, Messdienst, Vertrieb und Technik des Anbieters und unsere Vermittlungspartner. Du holst fehlende Unterlagen ein, hältst Fristen nach und vermittelst, wenn es hakt. Übergabe an den Anbieter: Objekte in das gemeinsame Portfolio-Sheet einstellen, Status pflegen, Begehungen koordinieren und den Vertragsprozess bis zur Unterschrift treiben. Partner-Netzwerk abrechnen: Vermittelte Objekte den Partnern zuordnen und Provisionen vorbereiten. Prozesse und Tools aufbauen: Du definierst, wann ein Objekt „vollständig“ und wann es „vertragsreif“ ist, schreibst die Abläufe auf und automatisierst mit Google Sheets, Drive und KI-gestützten Auswertungen, was heute Handarbeit ist. Dein Profil Erfahrung 3 bis 7 Jahre in einer Rolle, in der du viele Vorgänge parallel koordiniert hast, zum Beispiel: Projektleitung oder Projektassistenz bei einem Heizungsbauer, Energieversorger, Messdienst oder Contracting-Anbieter Objektmanagement oder Teamleitung in einer größeren Hausverwaltung Operations oder Customer Success in einem PropTech- oder Energie-Startup Projektsteuerung bei Sanierungen und Modernisierungen im Wohnungsbestand Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, zum Beispiel Immobilienkaufmann/-frau, Versorgungstechnik, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft. Projektmanagement Du hältst 80 Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer liegen bleibt, und entscheidest selbst, was Vorrang hat. Du kannst mit Eigentümern, Hausverwaltungen und Technikern gleichermaßen reden und hakst freundlich nach, auch zum dritten Mal wegen derselben Abrechnung. Du definierst Übergabepunkte und Fristen, hältst sie nach und kannst jederzeit sagen, wo die Pipeline steht. Fachlich Du kannst einen Energieausweis und eine Heizkostenabrechnung lesen und weißt, was eine Gasetagenheizung von einer Zentralheizung unterscheidet. Du verstehst, wie eine Hausverwaltung arbeitet, was eine WEG ist und wer beim Eigentümer entscheidet. Du rechnest gern, prüfst Zahlen auf Plausibilität und kannst eine Vergleichsrechnung erklären. Arbeitsweise und Tools Sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets, idealerweise hast du schon ein CRM oder Ticketsystem betrieben. Du schreibst Prozesse selbst auf und verbesserst sie, statt sie nur abzuarbeiten. Offen für KI-Tools im Alltag, weil ein großer Teil der Dokumentenauswertung darüber läuft. Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Pluspunkte: Kenntnisse im GEG oder CO2KostAufG, Erfahrung mit Wärmecontracting oder Energieberatung, Aufbau eines Backoffice von null. Was wir nicht suchen: Reine Sachbearbeitung ohne Koordinationserfahrung, oder Konzern-PMO mit Projekten, die 200 Tage Vorlauf haben. Bei uns sind die Projekte klein, viele und schnell. Was wir bieten Eine Rolle mit direktem Einfluss: Jedes Objekt, das du vertragsreif machst, ersetzt eine alte Gas- oder Ölheizung. Aufbauarbeit statt Verwaltung: Du definierst die Prozesse, die später ein Team von 4 bis 5 Leuten nutzt, und wächst mit in die Leitung von Operations. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Geschäftsführern und mit dem Team unseres Contracting-Partners. Festgehalt plus Beteiligung am Erfolg, abhängig von den vermittelten Wohneinheiten. Hybrides Arbeiten, Büro in Hamburg Moderne Tools: Google Workspace, KI-gestützte Auswertung von Unterlagen, keine Papierakten. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at <a id="menurhut" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="http://www.asteralabs.com/" target="_blank">www.asteralabs.com</a>.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer</strong></h1> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Germany (on-site)</p> <h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>Astera Labs is building purpose-built silicon for rack-scale AI infrastructure. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader driving ASIC design for next-generation Ethernet and Scale-Up (ESUN) connectivity products.</p> <p>You will set technical direction across the full ASIC design flow, spanning high-speed Ethernet, UALink, UCIe, and PCIe Gen 6/7. You will solve complex scale-up networking challenges, mentor senior engineers, and turn ambitious product goals into robust, manufacturable silicon.</p> <h2><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Architecture</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and drive ASIC architecture for Ethernet/ESUN connectivity products across UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and Ethernet.</li> <li>Lead architecture and microarchitecture for high-performance Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, packet processing pipelines, and AI interconnect fabrics.</li> <li>Define scalable, low-latency, high-bandwidth data movement, scheduling, buffering, congestion management, QoS, reliability, and flow control.</li> <li>Architect hardware acceleration for NIC functions, RDMA, DMA, virtualization, and protocol offloads.</li> <li>Lead tradeoff analysis across performance, power, area, latency, scalability, resiliency, and programmability.</li> <li>Serve as a technical authority across digital, networking, and system domains.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>ASIC Design &amp; Execution</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead RTL design and microarchitecture development for Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, protocol engines, and AI networking subsystems.</li> <li>Design packet processing architectures, DMA engines, queue management, scheduling, buffering, and memory subsystem interfaces.</li> <li>Develop hardware mechanisms for RDMA, zero-copy data movement, congestion control, transport reliability, and protocol acceleration.</li> <li>Design scalable architectures supporting virtualization, multi-tenant isolation, traffic management, and quality of service.</li> <li>Partner with firmware and software teams to define hardware/software interfaces for initialization, management, telemetry, performance monitoring, and diagnostics.</li> <li>Drive execution from architecture through RTL, integration, verification, tapeout, and post-silicon bring-up.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally to meet performance, timing, power, area, manufacturability, and reliability targets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>12+ years of ASIC/SoC design experience, with a track record of delivering complex, high-speed networking or connectivity silicon from architecture through production.</li> <li>Deep expertise in RTL design and microarchitecture for high-performance networking and connectivity ASICs.</li> <li>Extensive experience designing Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC architectures, packet processing engines, or network interface subsystems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of RDMA architectures and transport protocols such as RoCE, InfiniBand concepts, or similar low-latency networking technologies.</li> <li>Experience designing hardware for packet parsing, scheduling, buffering, DMA, queue management, flow control, congestion management, and transport acceleration.</li> <li>Strong understanding of high-speed interconnects and protocols, including Ethernet, PCIe, and AI scale-up fabrics.</li> <li>Hands-on experience across the complete ASIC development flow, including architecture, RTL design, integration, synthesis, timing closure, physical implementation, tapeout, and post-silicon validation.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams and product programs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.</li> <li>Direct experience with UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and/or advanced Ethernet architectures and protocols.</li> <li>Experience designing Ethernet MACs, controllers, SmartNICs, DPUs, NICs, switch datapaths, or packet processing engines.</li> <li>Experience developing Ethernet-based scale-up networking solutions for AI and HPC systems.</li> <li>Experience leading architecture or design for multiple successful advanced-node ASIC tapeouts.</li> <li>Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentorship skills.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description: <h2>About the Role&nbsp;</h2> <p>Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation &amp; Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.</p> <p><em>The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.</em></p> <h2>What You'll Own&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>&nbsp;Global Compensation Strategy &amp; Engine Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.</li> <li>Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.</li> <li>Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.</li> <li>Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experimentation &amp; Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics &amp; Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship &amp; Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&amp;L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy &amp; Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Stakeholder Accountability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.</li> <li>Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.</li> <li>Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.</li> <li>Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.</li> <li>Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.</li> <li>Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical &amp; Analytical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.</li> <li>Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.</li> <li>Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.</li> <li>Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Influence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.</li> <li>A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.</li> <li>Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.</li> <li>Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><em>Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg</em></li> <li><em>Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products</em></li> <li><em>Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning &amp; Development budget</em></li> <li><em>Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget&nbsp;</em></li> <li><em>Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program</em></li> <li><em>Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.</em></li> <li><em>Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes</em></li> <li><em>Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill</em></li> <li><em>Childcare and company pension scheme benefit</em></li> <li><em>Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT</em></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you'll be up to

  • Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.
  • Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.
  • Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.
  • Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.
  • Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.
  • Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.
  • Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you'll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

  • Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.
  • Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.
  • Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.
  • Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.
  • Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.
  • An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

  • Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.
  • Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.
  • Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

 

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschlandticket.
  • Team connection. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible.

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

raw.description:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers. 

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.
  • You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.
  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.
  • You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.
  • You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.
  • You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.
  • You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.
  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

  • Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.
  • A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.
  • Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.
  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

WHO WE ARE
At Proxima Fusion, we’re driven by a bold mission – to redefine the future of sustainable energy. Our unique concept, built upon the groundbreaking W7-X stellarator and the latest advances in technology, paves the way for commercially viable fusion power plants. What’s more, our work in stellarator optimization, powered by cutting-edge computation and machine learning is propelling us into uncharted territories of fusion technology. New higher performance design points are unlocked by high temperature superconducting magnets. To fully grasp this opportunity, we’re building a team of dedicated and passionate people who come together driving something extraordinary, radically transforming technology in the world.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION
You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You’ll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT
Join Proxima's Alpha Engineering Design team and help build Alpha, our flagship machine and the world's first high-temperature superconducting stellarator. Alpha is designed to de-risk the technologies needed for Stellaris, our future fusion power plant.
You'll take on a well-defined engineering project with real impact on Alpha's design. You'll work closely with experienced engineers and a technical mentor, and learn how a fusion machine goes from concept to hardware. Your role would be in the Magnet Support Structures team, responsible for structural and thermomechanical analysis of the systems that hold the superconducting coils in place under extreme electromagnetic and cryogenic loads.

Contribute to the design, analysis or testing of Alpha systems, working with the physics, mechanical and structural teams.

title: (Senior) Consultant Financial Services (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind EMPA ist eine Beratung für Data & Management Consulting mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Im Bereich Financial Services unterstützen wir Banken, Asset Manager, Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften, Depotführer und Verwahrstellen dabei, ihr Geschäft weiterzuentwickeln, Abläufe zu verbessern und neue Lösungen einzuführen. Bei uns bringst du deine Erfahrung und deine Ideen in Kundenprojekte ein. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung beim Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte zu setzen, neue Beratungsangebote zu entwickeln und unseren Financial-Services-Bereich mit aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben Als (Senior) Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden von der fachlichen Fragestellung bis zur Umsetzung. Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung arbeitest du als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer, Scrum Master oder im PMO. Perspektivisch kannst du auch als (Teil-)Projektleiter oder Product Owner Verantwortung übernehmen. Du analysierst Abläufe im Banking, Asset Management und Depotgeschäft und entwickelst Vorschläge, wie sich diese verbessern lassen. Du übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in verständliche Konzepte und konkrete Anforderungen, die du mit Fachbereichen und IT abstimmst. Du gestaltest digitale Produkte und Onboarding-Prozesse mit und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Plattformen und Schnittstellen. Du arbeitest an Daten- und KI-Vorhaben, verbesserst die Datenqualität und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, regulatorische Anforderungen in ihren Prozessen und Systemen umzusetzen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, führst Workshops durch und begleitest Tests sowie die Einführung neuer Lösungen. Du entwickelst mit uns Beratungsangebote, Methoden und Fachbeiträge und bringst dein Wissen in Kundengespräche ein. Das bringst du mit Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine entsprechende berufliche Qualifikation. Du bringst erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Banking oder Asset Management mit – aus einer Linienfunktion bei einem Finanzinstitut oder aus Beratungsprojekten für Banken, Asset Manager oder andere Finanzdienstleister. Du kennst dich in mindestens einem unserer Themenfelder aus – Depotgeschäft, Investment Operations, digitale Plattformen, Datenmanagement oder Projektsteuerung. Du hast Erfahrung im fachlichen Test, etwa bei der Erstellung von Testfällen, der Durchführung von Tests oder der Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Fehlern. Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen ein, erkennst Zusammenhänge und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären. Du arbeitest selbstständig, stimmst dich mit deinem Team ab und bringst eigene Vorschläge ein. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist bereit, abhängig vom Projekt auch vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten. Erfahrung mit Atlassian-Tools wie Jira und Confluence sowie ALM Octane ist willkommen. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Kenntnisse in BPMN, SQL oder Power BI. Wünschenswert sind Zertifizierungen in Scrum, PRINCE2, Requirements Engineering oder im Softwaretest, etwa ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) oder ISTQB Certified Tester Acceptance Testing (CT-AcT). Was wir dir bieten Anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte, in denen du Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung begleiten kannst. Die Möglichkeit, neue Beratungsangebote mitzuentwickeln und beim Ausbau unseres Financial-Services-Bereichs Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Schulungen und Weiterbildung, mit denen du dein Wissen vertiefen und neue fachliche Schwerpunkte erschließen kannst. Ein Team, das Erfahrungen teilt, gemeinsam an Lösungen arbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Eine attraktive Vergütung, die deine Erfahrung und deine Fähigkeiten berücksichtigt. Moderne Ausstattung, ein zentral gelegenes Büro in Frankfurt, regelmäßige Teamevents und eine Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft. Dein nächster Schritt Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin. Gemeinsam besprechen wir, ob der Einstieg als Consultant oder Senior Consultant zu deiner Erfahrung passt. description: Ein Betrieb läuft mit SO'USE, das Terminal funktioniert, die Gäste bestellen selbst. Und dann? Genau da setzt du an - schlägst noch die Anbindung der Lieferdienste und den eigenen Webshop vor. Gäste scannen einen QR-Code oder tippen am Self-Order-Terminal, bestellen selbst und zahlen direkt – die Bestellung landet ohne Umweg in der Kasse und auf dem Küchendisplay. Dazu kommen Webshop, Tablet-Bestellung und die Anbindung von Lieferdiensten wie Lieferando, Wolt und Uber Eats. Über 1.500 Betriebe arbeiten damit täglich: vom Foodtruck über Bäckereiketten bis zu HANS IM GLÜCK. Was du bei uns machst Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden aktiv, vor allem am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls, und suchst den Kontakt, bevor Probleme entstehen. Dein Ziel: Kunden nutzen das volle Produktportfolio von SO'USE, vom Self-Order-Terminal über Webshop und Tablet-Bestellung bis zur Lieferdienst-Anbindung. Du erkennst Upsell-Potenziale im Bestand und bringst sie im Gespräch auf den Tisch, passend zum Betrieb. Du wirkst durch Schulungen oder weitere Produkte darauf hin, dass möglichst viele Bestellungen per Onlinezahlung abgewickelt werden, und zeigst Betrieben, welchen Mehrwert das für sie hat. Du verstehst, wie ein Betrieb vor Ort wirklich arbeitet, und passt Empfehlungen und Lösungen an seine Prozesse an. Du nimmst Kritik und Beschwerden ernst, bleibst ruhig, hörst zu und wendest schwierige Situationen bis zur Kündigung zum Guten. Bei technischen Fragen arbeitest du eng mit Support und Entwicklung zusammen. Der Bereich ist im Aufbau. Du findest proaktiv Aufgaben, entwickelst Prozesse und Vorgehensweisen mit und gibst Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam weiter. Du nutzt KI-Tools, um Kundenkommunikation, Auswertungen und deine Arbeitsabläufe effizienter zu gestalten. Was du mitbringst Starke Kommunikation, besonders am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls. Du telefonierst gern und viel, auch mit Menschen, die gerade keine Zeit haben. Emotionale Intelligenz und Einfühlungsvermögen. Du kannst Kritik aushalten, Kunden beruhigen und Gespräche in eine konstruktive Richtung lenken. Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative. Du arbeitest gern selbstständig und packst Aufgaben an, bevor sie jemand verteilt. Gastro-Erfahrung! Du hast im Service, in der Küche, oder in der Betriebsleitung oder in gearbeitet und weißt, wie sich ein voller Laden anfühlt. Das hilft dir, Prozesse vor Ort zu verstehen. Verkaufsgeschick und Freude daran, Bestandskunden weiterzuentwickeln. Keine Berührungsängste mit KI. Du bist offen für neue Tools und nutzt sie selbstverständlich. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Neue Produkte und Prozesse sind für dich der spannende Teil. Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb, idealerweise in einem Gastrotech-Unternehmen Erfahrung mit Gastro-Kassensystemen Was wir bieten Vergütung: Gesamtvergütung von 45.000 bis 60.000 Euro im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Zielerreichung. Sie setzt sich aus einem festen Gehalt und einem variablen Bonus zusammen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst einen Bereich, der sich schnell entwickelt, und bringst deine Ideen direkt ein. Perspektive: Wer bei uns Kunden und Produkt kennt, hat gute Chancen, den Bereich perspektivisch als Teamleitung zu entwickeln. Arbeitsplatz: Vorzugsweise in Leipzigs Mitte, aber auch remote möglich. Wir sitzen gern zusammen im Büro, aber wenn du von woanders arbeitest, funktioniert das auch. Arbeitskultur: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und ein entspannter Umgang im Team. Entwicklung: Regelmäßiges Feedback und Workshops statt Jahresgespräch. Klingt nach dir? Dann schreib uns. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und dein Lebenslauf reichen uns völlig. Erzähl uns gern, aus welchem Laden du kommst. Fragen vorab? Melde dich einfach direkt, auch ohne fertige Bewerbung. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Database Engineering Intern
description: We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks. Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible Tasks Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled. Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed. Improve our data models : reduce duplicated values and work with references and views. Optimise data access so that more work happens in the database and less in the application. Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference. Review our database access policies. Requirements You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar. Comfortable in SQL : joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan. You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it. PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus. Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation . Experience with AI-assisted development tools . Humble, low ego , not afraid to get your hands dirty. Get things done mentality : prioritising results over process. Fluent in English, German is a plus. Benefits Scaling from 0 to 1 : you shape how this company works, from the processes to the team around you. Work as a full team member of an interdisciplinary team of top performers that will both support and challenge your growth. Lunch allowance , a subsidized sports membership and modern tech. A new office in Garching , right on top of our own production floor. Vetaion is building a fully automated production facility for control cabinets in Munich. We use digital twins and robotics to automate the manufacturing process, orchestrated by VetaionOS, our own operating system for the factory. description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong>: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar</li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators.&nbsp;</strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career.&nbsp;</strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>🏆 <strong>Rewarding Impact from Day One</strong></p> <p>You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.</p> <p><strong>🍎Learning &amp; development&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our <strong>Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics</strong> is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>🗺️Relocation</strong></p> <p>If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.</p> <p><strong>⛳All the rest&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a <strong>Master's degree</strong>, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.</p> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong> English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)</p> <p><strong>What are the long-term opportunities after the program? </strong>This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover.&nbsp;</p> <p>Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2IRqvZkJcMY?si=Z1fgP9D6WGVQcG1R" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀 Aufgaben Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen. Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung. Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance. Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden. Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen. PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren. Qualifikation Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich. Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern. Analytisches Denken: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Zahlen und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, zeichnen dich aus. Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert. Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist. Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben. Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur. Ausstattung : Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben. raw.title: Agent Shop and Stations - Victoria Coach Station (On-site)
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for motivated and driven Agent Shops and Stations for Victoria Coach Station (On-site) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success.

About the Role

  • Act as the face of FlixBus UK at one of the UK's busiest coach stations, Victoria Coach Station, delivering a welcoming and seamless customer experience from journey start to departure
  • Assist existing and prospective customers with ticketing queries, journey information, operational updates, cancellations, and delays
  • Drive revenue by selling tickets and promoting relevant FlixBus add-ons to passengers
  • Support drivers and customers by conducting ticket checks, passenger check-ins, and ensuring smooth boarding processes
  • Carry out vehicle audits and quality checks before departure to help maintain service standards and enhance the customer journey
  • Coordinate with station partners and TfL staff to manage live departures and ensure the efficient flow of passengers through the station
  • Respond to incidents, disruptions, delays, and cancellations, keeping customers informed and minimising network disruption while helping passengers continue their journeys smoothly

About You

  • Enjoy providing great customer service and have the ability to deal with difficult situations whilst remaining professional at all times
  • Have previous experience of working in a customer-facing role
  • Possess excellent communication skills
  • Are able to work on a flexible rota including shifts from Monday to Sunday between 06:00 and 00:00
  • Thrive in high pressure, fast moving and dynamic environments
  • See yourself as proactive, motivated, autonomous and have a desire to grow with a business
  • Are able to prioritize key tasks and make decisions quickly on sometimes, limited information

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

raw.title: Customer Marketing Associate
raw.description:
Customer Marketing Manager

Hi, I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market. We're growing the team because customer case studies are critical to our success: insurance is a tight-knit industry that trusts practitioner voices far more than it trusts vendors.

This role is a chance to help shape the narrative we take to market and have a global impact on our success. You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Product Marketing team

Product Marketing sits at the centre of hx's go-to-market engine, translating what we build into stories the market believes. Nothing earns that belief faster than a customer saying it themselves: insurance is an industry where reputation travels through a small number of trusted voices, and our customers include some of the most respected names in specialty and commercial insurance.

As our Customer Marketing Manager, you'll own that voice. Your mission is to increase the frequency, quality, and number of published customer case studies, build relationships with customer accounts so that every testimonial is genuinely mutually beneficial, find new ways to celebrate our customers, and manage award submissions that earn industry recognition for hx and the customers we serve.

This is a role with real ownership from day one. You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at hx and at some of the world's largest insurers, and the content you produce will be used across sales, marketing, and events globally.

What you'll be doing

  • Own case study production end to end - from identifying the story and recruiting the customer through to publication - delivering two published case studies (written, video, or otherwise) per quarter.

  • Publish two additional pieces of customer-contributed content per quarter, from quotes and social content to event appearances, driving hx's key messages to market through customer voices.

  • Build and continually improve our case study recruitment and production process so that participating is low-lift for both our customers and our team, and each cycle runs smoother than the last.

  • Grow engagement across the underwriting community, measured through event attendance, email open rates, and social engagement, particularly on LinkedIn.

  • Identify and manage award submissions throughout the year, coordinating internal and customer stakeholders to produce a targeted number of high-quality entries that increase industry recognition for hx and its customers.

  • Edit and assemble short-form written, video, and social content for promotion and lead generation, keeping every asset aligned with hx's positioning and brand narrative.

What you'll need to have done

  • Taken customer stories or content projects from initial idea through to publication, coordinating multiple senior, time-limited stakeholders inside and outside your organisation.

  • Built content programmes or campaigns where the relationship mattered as much as the output - securing participation, managing approvals and consent, and leaving customers glad they took part.

  • Produced short-form written and video content yourself, with the functional writing and editing skills to create new assets and make light edits without waiting on others.

  • Grown an audience or generated leads through social content, particularly by editing and assembling content for LinkedIn.

  • Demonstrated strong instincts for positioning and messaging - shaping stories that align with a brand narrative rather than just documenting what happened.

  • Improved a process so it lasted: found the friction, fixed it, and made the next cycle measurably easier for everyone involved.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer being handed a finished brief over hunting down a story, winning people over, and solving problems as you find them.

  • You see customers primarily as a source of quotes rather than partners whose goals, reputation, and time deserve as much care as our own.

  • You're uncomfortable coordinating multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and limited availability.

  • If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview Process

  1. Talent Partner Screen (30-45 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45-60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment (60 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60-90 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO/CMO/CRO (approximately 40 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.
