raw.title: Head of Revenue Enablement
raw.description:
Hi, I'm Romain - SVP Global Sales at hx.

I joined hx six months ago because I saw a rare mix of things: a deeply talented team, a product that is genuinely changing how insurers make decisions, and the ambition to build something category-defining in one of the world's most important industries.

The commercial opportunity in front of us is huge, but it is also complex. We sell into a market where credibility matters, where our customers are actuaries, underwriters and senior insurance leaders, and where AI needs to create real business value, not just a better story.

That is why we are hiring our first Head of Revenue Enablement. This person will help us build the operating rhythm, onboarding, materials and enablement programmes that make our global Revenue team sharper, more consistent and more credible in the field.

A note on level: we're open on seniority for this hire. What matters most is finding the right person to build this function from scratch, not matching a specific title. If your experience sits closer to a senior enablement lead than a Head, we still want to hear from you, see the companion Revenue Enablement Lead posting for a version calibrated closer to that level.

This is not a role where you inherit a finished playbook, and it is not a role that comes with a team or budget to build one out immediately. It is a role for someone who wants to build the first version properly, hands-on, working closely with Revenue leadership, and help shape how hx sells as we continue to scale.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

hx's commercial engine is scaling rapidly, and Revenue Enablement sits at the heart of making that scale sustainable. Today, enablement happens across pockets of the organisation, Revenue leadership, RevOps, Sales Ops, Product Marketing, and Marketing, but there's no single owner, no operating cadence, and no clear system for turning commercial strategy into repeatable field execution.

This is where you come in. You'll be building hx's first dedicated Revenue Enablement function from scratch, working in close partnership with Romain and the wider commercial leadership team. Your mission is to close the gap between intent and execution: improving how our sellers are trained, equipped, motivated, and held to a consistent operating rhythm that drives revenue.

You'll take an AI-first approach to how enablement gets built at hx. That means using AI tools to accelerate content creation, calibrate messaging against live deal data, and build feedback loops faster than a traditional enablement function could, not just producing more content, but producing a smarter, faster system.

In this role, you'll treat enablement as a system, not a content library. You'll bring structure and pace to a high-performing sales organisation, staying close to the customer, the field, and the behaviours that actually move deals forward. This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and sees the opportunity to shape how a world-class commercial team operates, hands-on, not from a distance.

Check out our Sales and Partnerships Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Build hx's first Revenue enablement operating model, defining clear scope, ownership, intake processes, prioritisation frameworks, and success metrics that make enablement predictable and aligned to commercial priorities.

  • Create and execute the 2026 Revenue enablement roadmap, translating commercial OKRs into a focused programme of training, content, and rhythms that improve seller effectiveness and execution discipline.

  • Drive measurable improvements in seller behaviour, designing enablement programmes that strengthen qualification, discovery, deal progression, sales process adherence, Salesforce hygiene, and forecasting accuracy.

  • Strengthen customer-centric selling by equipping the sales team with better customer insight, references, case studies, proof points, and value messaging that make sellers more credible and commercially sharp in every conversation.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, and ABM to ensure sellers can confidently use targeted messaging, launch materials, competitive positioning, and customer stories in the field.

  • Design scalable onboarding and continuous learning programmes with clear curriculum, measurable ramp indicators, manager reinforcement, and defined productivity milestones for commercial hires.

  • Use AI tools directly and hands-on to build, iterate, and scale enablement assets and programmes rather than relying solely on manual content production.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built or significantly scaled Revenue enablement in a B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or complex commercial environment, demonstrating that enablement is about changing seller behaviour, not just producing training content.

  • Designed and implemented enablement operating models that include intake, governance, stakeholder alignment, measurement, and repeatable cadences across Revenue, Marketing, Product Marketing, and Operations teams.

  • Delivered programmes that measurably improved seller effectiveness, such as better discovery execution, increased win rates, faster ramp times, improved Salesforce adoption, or stronger commercial discipline in live deals.

  • Partnered cross-functionally with senior commercial leaders, earning trust through pragmatic judgement, clear prioritisation, and demonstrable revenue impact rather than relying on formal authority.

  • Created structured onboarding and ongoing learning programmes that shortened time-to-productivity for new hires, with clear curriculum, reinforcement mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.

  • Used customer insight, market context, references, and proof points to improve how sellers engage with prospects, demonstrating commercial credibility and customer-centricity in enablement design.

  • Been comfortable building alone, without a team, at least in the first phase of the role.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • Your experience is mainly in content production, LMS administration, or training delivery without building the operating system and structure around enablement.

  • You need an existing playbook to follow, or see enablement as separate from sales execution, commercial strategy, customer insight, and cross-functional operating cadence.

  • You're a strategist who struggles with hands-on delivery, or someone who prefers working in isolation rather than collaborating closely with Revenue leadership, Marketing, RevOps, and frontline sellers.

  • You're looking for a role with a team and budget to build out from day one.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energized, hx may not be the place where you will do your best work. We are building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off.

  2. Manager interview with our SVP of Sales.

  3. Skills assessment: 60-minute working session where you'll present your diagnosis of the enablement opportunity at hx, a proposed 6-month enablement plan, your operating model for intake and prioritisation, and one example enablement programme designed to improve seller behaviour in practice.

  4. Values interview + Meet the CEO

  5. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

What that looks like day to day As a GRC Engineer at incident.io , you own how we prove we’re doing the right thing: our compliance programme, our customer security questionnaires, and the evidence behind both. One day you’re building an AI workflow that drafts questionnaire answers, the next you’re pushing our ISO 27001 work forward, the next you’re telling the product team what makes GRC painful. European customers are not evaluating us out of curiosity. Workforce compliance has turned into a board-level risk and there are deadlines attached to it. The demand is already here. What we don't have is coverage, or an enterprise motion that repeats.

As a Partner Services Manager (EMEA), you will support the execution and delivery of Optro’s partner services strategy by owning key partner relationships, enablement initiatives, and delivery outcomes.

Partner Enablement & Delivery Readiness:

  • Execute structured partner enablement training plans aligned to partner maturity and Optro modules

  • Continuous enablement of partners - monthly calls covering new features, methodology and tooling updates

  • Support partners in building and operationalizing Centres of Excellence, driving delivery readiness and scalability

  • Track partner capability development and readiness milestones, escalating risks and gaps proactively

  • Act as the day-to-day Partner Services owner for assigned partners

  • Develop expertise in partner services best practices with a growth path toward people leadership

  • 8+ years related experience, with a minimum of 2 years of Optro Experience working with the Optro Platform or other GRC platforms

  • Experience working with partners in an enterprise software ecosystem (training, escalations, monthly webinar, advisor)

  • Trained across multiple product lines and willingness to learn modules outside current scope

  • Experience working across multifaceted teams to deliver on software implementation engagements

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including comfort presenting to senior audiences

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify root causes and drive cross functional process improvement

title: Credit Manager (H/F)
description: Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé. Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions. Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout. Votre mission Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier. Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision. Ce que vous ferez Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir. Traiter les litiges à la racine avec nos équipes Opérations, Planning et Expérience Client. Animer le comité de crédit hebdomadaire : comptes à bloquer, à débloquer, conditions de paiement. Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance. Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours. Faire progresser le dispositif avec l’agent IA, et former nos commerciaux au réflexe « se faire payer ». Votre profil 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services. Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme. Les bases juridiques du recouvrement et des procédures collectives. De la rigueur, de la ténacité, et l’habitude d’un logiciel comptable (Pennylane idéalement) et d’un tableur. L’envie de travailler avec des outils d’IA et de les pousser plus loin. Ce que nous proposons Un CDI à Paris 15e. 40 000 à 45 000 € brut par an selon l’expérience, plus 5 000 € de variable sur objectifs. Un impact visible dès le premier mois : chaque jour de délai gagné, c’est du cash pour financer la croissance du groupe. Des outils qui vous libèrent du travail répétitif. Notre process Un premier échange avec un dirigeant, un entretien avec votre futur manager, un test technique puis un entretien « culture ». Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Hiring DRI conversation: discussion with a senior member of the product team. Product exercise: collaboration exercise based on a real company priority. Founder conversation: discussion with one of our founders on product judgment, attitude, and ability to operate with distributed authority. Onsite: working sessions with members of Engineering, Design, and GTM. We care more about the quality of your reasoning and collaboration than about arriving at a predetermined answer. What We're Looking For Founding PM mentality: Senior individual contributor and builder balancing capacity to build the practice in the company while being hands-on. 5–8+ years of product experience, including time at an early-stage company where you had to build process from scratch. Genuine product taste. You know great from good in the world of tech products, and you bring deep perspective, judgment and conviction to any preferences you voice. Excellent information synthesis skills, distilling a messy pile of customer feedback, sales calls, and Slack threads into sharp problems. Technical proficiency earn the respect of engineers. You don't need to code, but you understand systems and tradeoffs easily deeply. Builder mindset at heart. You use AI tools fluently and you're excited about what they unlock for how PMs operate. You've thrived in environments where everyone is a builder and you want to strengthen that. Effective communication. You'd rather say one clear thing than three vague things. Comfort with distributed authority. You influence by being right, not by being in charge. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work.   • Qualify and synthesize feedback: Sit at the intersection of GTM, users, and product. Turn high-volume, unstructured input into a small set of well-framed problems worth solving.

  • Shape initiatives: Work with engineers and designers to translate validated problems into initiatives ready for Stack Rank — with clear objectives, KPIs, and scope.

  • Drive outcome tracking: Own reporting on whether what shipped actually moved the needle. Feed that back into the next round of decisions.

  • Improve internal coordination: Connect Marketing, Comms, GTM, and Product — reduce the friction that slows things down when multiple functions need to move together.

  • Own outcomes, not outputs: For cross-functional initiatives, you'll own the goal — objectives, KPIs, orchestration, reporting.

  • Own artefacts in the Dust platform (agents, skills, data, etc..) to continuously rewire and augment the above for yourself and the team

What You Can Expect

Team

Dust is a growing team of about a 100 people. Most of the product and engineering team is based in Paris, with close collaboration across our teams in New York, San Francisco, and London.

The interview process

The process is designed to understand how you think, collaborate, and operate in an ambiguous, technical environment:

  • Recruiter conversation: motivation, background, logistics, and fit for an early-stage environment.

  • Hiring DRI conversation: discussion with a senior member of the product team.

  • Product exercise: collaboration exercise based on a real company priority.

  • Founder conversation: discussion with one of our founders on product judgment, attitude, and ability to operate with distributed authority.

  • Onsite: working sessions with members of Engineering, Design, and GTM. We’ll look at how you gather context, identify the important problems, collaborate on possible approaches, and leave ownership with the people closest to the work.

  • Builder mindset at heart. You use AI tools fluently and you're excited about what they unlock for how PMs operate. You've thrived in environments where everyone is a builder and you want to strengthen that.

  • Effective communication. You'd rather say one clear thing than three vague things.

  • Comfort with distributed authority. You influence by being right, not by being in charge.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

We are looking for a hands-on Oracle Xstore solution architect to join the Design Pod of a global luxury retail POS transformation. A standard Oracle Xstore and SIOCS template is being rolled out to boutiques in around 36 countries (2027 to 2030), delivered through a Design Pod, a Base Template Pod and regional EU and APAC PODs, under a standard-first (90/10) principle.

You will own the end-to-end solution design for Xstore Point of Service and Xstore Office, so each market is designed on the global template with minimal, well-governed customisation, completing design for 3 to 4 work packages a year.

You will be measured on low design-related defects, template conformance and on-time design delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Fit-gap and Adopt-vs-Adapt assessments per market, with documented standard vs. custom recommendations
  • Solution designs and FSDs for POS flows: sales, returns, exchanges, clienteling, payments, tax and receipts
  • Country localisation: fiscalization, tax, e-invoicing, fiscal printers and Oracle country-pack usage or gaps
  • Technical design inputs for customisations, extensions and integrations, traceable to requirements and tests
  • Integration designs between Xstore and payments, tax, order management, CRM, ERP, e-commerce and SIOCS

Requirements

  • Oracle Retail and cloud integration patterns; fiscal and tax requirements across Europe, APAC and the Americas
  • 15+ years in retail technology and 8+ years designing Oracle Xstore solutions (Senior Principal: 18+ years, several global rollouts as lead architect)
  • Lead or chief architect on a multi-country POS rollout, ideally 10+ countries
  • Strong luxury, fashion or premium retail background: clienteling, high-touch boutique processes, multi-brand and multi-currency
  • Experience governing a standard-first template and working across multiple vendors; Oracle Retail or Xstore certification is a plus

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture. Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis. Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers. Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy.

Responsibilities

  • Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions.

  • Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries.

  • Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture.

  • AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum.

  • Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis.

  • Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers.

  • Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

  • 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications.

  • Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation.

  • Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems.

  • Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines.

  • Fluency in English required; French is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. About the Role As Validation Laboratory Module Lead , you build Harmattan's environmental test laboratory from a blank page and then run it. Today too much of our environmental testing depends on external labs and their scheduling, which slows our development down as much as it costs us. Your mission is to change that, and you own it end to end: defining the capabilities we need, specifying and buying the machines, contributing to the choice of premises, recruiting and leading the technicians, and drawing the line between what we bring in-house and what stays external. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, and the lab does not exist yet. Beyond building it, you become the Group's reference on environmental testing: supporting the validation teams on the lab validation of their projects, reviewing the environmental parts of their test plans, and handing our test procedures over to the quality team as products move into production. What you'll do Define the lab and select the equipment: Establish the capabilities we need, then specify, evaluate and procure the machines, covering climatic and thermal cycling, water and dust ingress, vibration and UV ageing, including a large climate room in which we can fly a drone under controlled wind and temperature. Decide what we internalise and what stays external: Draw the line between the tests worth owning and those better bought from external labs, such as accredited qualification or rare capital-heavy tests, and revisit that line as our product range grows. Set up the facility: Contribute to the choice of premises, then take the site from layout and utilities through to installation, safety and commissioning. Build and lead the team: Recruit and lead a team of two to three lab technicians, set the working standards, and grow the team's capability as the lab ramps up. Support the validation teams: Assist the validation modules on the lab validation of their projects, and peer-review the environmental sections of their test plans, making sure the right tests, conditions and acceptance criteria are defined. Hand over to production: Work with the quality team to transfer our test procedures as products reach PVT and mass production, so that production-line testing stays consistent with what validation defined. What we're looking for At least 10 years in environmental testing , including setting up or substantially developing a test lab. This is a senior role and we are looking for depth, not a first lab job. Strong command of environmental test methods and the equipment behind them: climatic and thermal cycling, vibration, water and dust ingress, UV, and the standards that frame them. Proven equipment judgement: able to specify, evaluate and procure test machines, and to argue build-versus-buy and in-house-versus-external on both cost and technical merit. Experience leading a small technical team, or clear readiness to step into that responsibility. A rigorous, methodical approach to test planning, acceptance criteria and documentation. Comfortable working across functions with engineering, validation and quality, and translating between them. Engineering degree in a relevant field (mechanical, materials, electronics, physics or similar), or equivalent experience. Bonus: experience with defence or aerospace test standards (MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160 or similar); familiarity with lab accreditation and metrological traceability such as ISO/IEC 17025; a background in drones or robotics. Working-level English; French is a plus. Based at our Paris-area site, with occasional travel to our Swiss site. title: Embedded Software Engineer - SoM
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight. RESPONSIBILITIES BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions. Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update. Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces. Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs. Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary. Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers. CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved. Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage. Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image. Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout. Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git). Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf. Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Au cœur de notre visibilité, tu seras le moteur de notre création de contenu et de nos prises de parole. 1. Réseaux Sociaux & Notoriété de Marque Élaboration stratégique & animation : piloter nos prises de parole sur LinkedIn et Instagram. Trouver les angles, concevoir le calendrier éditorial et animer la communauté. Storytelling & Formats : vulgariser l'actualité tech, imaginer des carrousels percutants et mettre en lumière les sociétés qui lèvent des fonds chez nous. Distribution : assurer la mise en ligne sur les plateformes audio (Spotify, Apple...) et YouTube avec des visuels et miniatures qui donnent envie de cliquer. 3. Création Visuelle, Ads & Supports Clés (Decks & Slides) Decks & Présentations : concevoir et mettre en page des présentations visuelles irréprochables (Pitch Decks, présentations partenaires, bilans) pour valoriser Sowefund auprès de toutes nos parties prenantes. Assets visuels : créer les visuels, bannières et carrousels pour rythmer les annonces de levées et les temps forts de la marque. Formats publicitaires : décliner les créas visuelles pour nos campagnes d'acquisition payante (Meta Ads, Google Ads). 4. Gestion de Projet Communication Être le garant de la cohérence de l'image de marque et du ton Sowefund sur l'ensemble des points de contact. CE QUE TU APPRENDS ICI Une liberté d’action directe : une structure agile où tes initiatives du matin peuvent être concrétisées l'après-midi. Une immersion dans l'écosystème tech : des échanges directs avec les fondateurs et figures de l'écosystème startup français. Un portfolio concret et valorisable : tes présentations, formats vidéos, podcasts et créations visuelles touchent une audience de grande envergure. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Formation : BAC+3 à BAC+5 en École de Communication, Médias, Journalisme ou École de Commerce. Sens du format & réseaux : tu maîtrises les codes de TikTok, LinkedIn et Instagram pour capter l'attention dès les premières secondes. Boîte à outils créative : tu es à l'aise sur Canva, PowerPoint / Google Slides ou Figma pour structurer des présentations claires et élégantes, et sur CapCut / Premiere pour monter des vidéos courtes. Aisance rédactionnelle : une plume vive, une orthographe irréprochable et un esprit de synthèse pour rendre limpide n'importe quel sujet complexe. Énergie et curiosité : envie de proposer des idées neuves et de tester des formats originaux sans attendre un brief rigide. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? 🍿 About Staycation

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 4,000 partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have at least 5 years of professional software development experience, with a track record of shipping and owning meaningful product features.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

  • Recruiter interview with Mathieu, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

  • Manager interview with Robin, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

  • Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim, our Tech Leads (60 min)

title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . Vos compétences Votre profil Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée . Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées. Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée. Votre expertise technique Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment : électricité HT/BT ; systèmes de secours électrique ; UPS / groupes électrogènes ; CVC / HVAC ; refroidissement ; protection incendie ; contrôle-commande ; maintenance des infrastructures critiques. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées. Votre expérience opérationnelle Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante. Vous êtes à l'aise avec : les modes opératoires (MOP) ; la gestion des changements ; l'analyse de risques ; la maintenance préventive et corrective ; la gestion d'incidents critiques ; les audits et contrôles opérationnels ; les REX ; la standardisation des pratiques ; la gestion de prestataires techniques. Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation , de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations. Vos qualités Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne : dotée d'une forte expertise technique ; structurée et rigoureuse ; capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ; pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ; à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ; capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ; dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ; capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ; fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ; capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement. Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante. description: Contexte : ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. raw.title: Technical Implementation Manager (all genders) – French & German Speaking
raw.description:
Bist du bereit, dich mit uns auf eine spannende Reise zu begeben? Wir leben #own (y)our growth und fördern ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Technical Implementation Manager (all genders) trägst du die Hauptverantwortung für unsere neuen und laufenden Projekte in der Schweiz. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team sorgst du dafür, dass sich die Anzahl unserer aktiven Parkflächen stetig vergrössert.

 

Um unsere innovativen Ideen und ambitionierten Visionen voranzutreiben, suchen wir Talente wie dich!

 

What to expect

  • Technische Planung: Du bist verantwortlich für die technische Planung unserer Parkplätze, dies beinhaltet die Analyse und Festlegung der Positionen unserer Hardware auf der Parkfläche.

  • Koordinierung: Du steuerst interne und externe Ressourcen zur Sicherstellung des Projektfortschritts und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams im Operations-Bereich und darüber hinaus zusammen

  • Installationsplanung: Du planst Installationen und Instandhaltung und zeigst Kreativität bei der Lösung aller vor Ort auftretenden Probleme

  • Kundenmanagement: Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Projekte und koordinierst mit dem Kunden eine reibungslose Installation / Inbetriebnahme

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du hinterfragst den Status quo und sorgst für eine kontinuierliche Prozessoptimierung

  • Reporting: Du berichtest regelmässig KPIs an Tim, deinem zukünftigen Team Lead und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen

 

Inspire us by

  • Background: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der (technischen) Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Experience: Du bringst ca. 2-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder Operations-Bereich mit

  • Technische Affinität: Du verfügst über räumliches Denkvermögen, einen technischen Sachverstand und über eine "Hands-on" Mentalität

  • Arbeitsweise: Analytisches Denken sowie strukturiertes und gründliches Arbeiten zählen zu deinen Stärken

  • Think out of the box: Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich und überzeugst durch deine Proaktivität und durch dein lösungsorientiertes Denken

  • Aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit: Du hast ein sicheres Auftreten in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und Französisch, idealerweise auch Schweizerdeutsch

 

What we offer

  • Flexibilität: Mit unserem hybriden Arbeitsmodell kannst du deinen Arbeitsrhythmus individuell anpassen und an unseren Anchor-Days (Dienstag bis Donnerstag) Zeit mit deinem Team in unserem Office in Wallisellen verbringen

  • Messbare Ziele: Mit unseren OKRs ist dein Einfluss auf unseren Produkt- und Unternehmenserfolg direkt messbar

  • KI im Alltag: KI ist bei uns kein Buzzword, sondern Teil deines Workflows – für bessere Insights, schnellere Lösungen und weniger repetitive Aufgaben

  • Events: Feiere gemeinsam unsere Erfolge bei unseren legendären Teamevents oder unseren Spirit Days

  • Verpflegung: Nutze unsere Lunch Card – der smarte, steuerbegünstigte Weg zu deinen täglichen Mahlzeiten, flexibel einlösbar bei zahlreichen Food-Partnern

  • Workation: Arbeite 2 Wochen im Jahr an Orten deiner Wahl oder lerne dein Team auf einer gemeinsamen Team Week besser kennen

  • Equipment: Entscheide selbst über dein eigenes Equipment, um effizient und komfortabel zu arbeiten

  • Dresscode: Kleide dich so, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst

 

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,  Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.   Position description We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles. What you will do Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services. Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems. Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access. Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls. Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP. Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations. Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts. Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices. Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation. Experience and qualifications 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk. Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos. Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript). Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM). Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access. Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Additional comments This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.  Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered. raw.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
raw.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

  • Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.

  • Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.

  • Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications

  • 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.

  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.

  • Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).

  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).

  • Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. title: WerkstudentIn Sales & Business Development Legal AI (40–80%)
description: Über Jurata Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Der Legal Agent übernimmt Recherche, Drafting und die Überarbeitung von Dokumenten und belegt seine Antworten mit Millionen verifizierter Erlasse, Gerichtsentscheide und weiterer relevanter Quellen. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen. Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Rolle KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding. Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst. Deine Aufgaben Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine. title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.       About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging . We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role . Tasks

For the next expansion step, 3Brain is looking for a full-time Hardware electronics engineer to reinforce our R&D team.   • Design and implement hardware systems and sub-systems (PCBs), including high-speed ADCs, microcontrollers and FPGA-SoMs, power supplies, etc.

  • Bringing-up, testing, measuring, characterization and validation of electronic systems

  • Design and development of production test tools

  • Make, assemble, debug and test demonstrators and prototype devices

  • Documentation (engineering, production, QA, etc.)

Required Qualifications

  • Independence and ability to communicate and work effectively with other team members in a multicultural and international environment

  • BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in HW Design

  • Design of analog electronics and high-speed digital systems (Simulation, Schematics, HDI Layout)

  • Detailed understanding of PCB-manufacturing

  • Good understanding of EMC compliance and mechanical integration

  • Practical and industrial hands-on experience (e.g. prototype soldering, setting up test-benches, transfer and scale-up to mass production, etc.)

  • Prototyping and testing (i.e. for bring-up, debugging and production)

  • Background in basic signal processing (i.e. sampling, filtering, aliasing, etc.)

  • Fluency in English

Additional Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Python

  • Microprocessor programming

Benefits

  • A dynamic and stimulating work environment driven by a desire to build transformational technologies to help others.

  • A young, fast-growing company with plenty of opportunities for personal growth and development.

  • Great challenges and adventures in both technical and economical fields.

  • Working place: Pfäffikon SZ, Switzerland. It is a lakeside village just outside of Zurich, the country’s main cultural, financial and business center.

The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned. Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.
