description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Switzerland. In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy. Accountabilities Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts. AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations. Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors. Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures. Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs. Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch. Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives. E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions. Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment. Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts. Requirements Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition. Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms. Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions. Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products. Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines. English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions. Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce. Strongly preferred: Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products. Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement. Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations. Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites. Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor. Nice to have: Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers. Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations. Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities. Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation. Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development. Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects. Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches. AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. raw.title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
raw.description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. 


What You'll Do

  • Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. 

  • Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. 

  • Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. 

  • Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

  • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. 

  • Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. 

  • Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. 

  • Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. 

  • Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. 


What You'll Need

Leadership & Product Team Experience 

  • A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. 

  • A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. 

  • A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. 

  • Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. 

  • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. 

  • Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. 

  • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. 

  • Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. 

Cartography & Digital Map Making 

  • A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. 

  • Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. 

  • Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. 

  • Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. 

  • Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. 

Map Visualisation & Rendering 

  • Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. 

  • Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. 

  • Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. 

  • Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. 

AI in Your Practice 

  • Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. 

  • Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. 

  • Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. 

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. 

  • Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. 

  • User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. 

  • High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. 


Nice to Have

  • Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. 

  • Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. 

  • Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar. 

  • Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements. 

  • Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins. 

  • Experience contributing to design systems at scale. 

What we offer

A competitive compensation package, of course.  

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 

Meet your team

We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.


At TomTom...

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


After you apply

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

•  Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

•  Keep our databases fast and reliable.

•  Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

•  Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

•  Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

•  Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

•  Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

•  Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

•  Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

•  Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

•  Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

•  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

•  Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

•  Front end: TypeScript and React.

•  Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

•  Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

•  Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

•  Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

•  Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

•  A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

•  Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

•  Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

•  A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

•  Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

•  A small team working with major enterprise clients.

•  Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

•  Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

•  High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

•  The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

•  Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

•  Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

•  Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

•  Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

•  Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

•  Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

•  Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. What you'll be doing Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others What you'll need You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick Nice to have Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar) Our stack Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS. None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply. How we hire Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one: Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values. Meet the Founder. You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.   We offer Competitive compensation . We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days Pension. 6% employer contribution Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over Learning and coaching. raw.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
raw.description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
  • Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
  • Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

    • Nice to have
  • Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

    • Our stack

    Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

    None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    How we hire
    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:
    1. Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    2. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
    3. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
    4. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    5. Meet the Founder.
    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.

  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution

description: About Us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production. The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster. What you’ll do: Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage What you’ll bring: 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them. Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake) Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs. This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. raw.description:
About Us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.
Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

About the role:

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services

  • Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

  • Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

  • Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

  • Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

  • Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

  • Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

  • Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

  • Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

  • Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

  • Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

  • A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers .

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Projectontwikkelaar
description: Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.   Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.   Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. ·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie; ·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's; ·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders; ·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken; ·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering; ·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming; ·       Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces; ·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie; ·       Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. Dit breng jij mee ·       Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie; ·       Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; ·       Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen; ·       Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).; ·       Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten; ·       Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken;  ·       Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie. Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card.  Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical. Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen? Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Bel, whatsapp of e-mail interim recruiter Arnold van Stade via 06-18702179 of ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;"> Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van “onderaannemers”. Bij acquisitie behouden we ons het recht voor om meerwerk in rekening te brengen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Work closely with colleagues across SkyNRG to ensure customers receive a seamless experience. Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers. About the role

As a Senior Business Development Lead at SkyNRG, you’ll build and grow partnerships with large corporate customers looking to address the emissions associated with their business travel and air freight.

You’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and growing existing ones, from understanding a company’s sustainability goals and business needs to shaping proposals, negotiating agreements and closing deals. Working with senior decision makers and colleagues across SkyNRG, you’ll help customers understand how SAF certificates (SAFc) can form part of their approach to reducing aviation-related emissions.

This is a senior commercial role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex sales processes and turning customer interest into long-term partnerships. You’ll combine strategic account development with a hands-on approach to progressing opportunities and delivering commercial results.

title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces. Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta. Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren. Jouw profiel SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen Welkome extra kennis en ervaring: Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management Over DSL-01 In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta. DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten. De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Waarom deze rol? Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken. Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek. Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌ Solliciteer Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart. NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌ Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com . 📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken. title: Technical Program Manager
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! Join us as a Technical Program Manager in our new Project Management Office (PMO), reporting to the PMO Lead. You will own day-to-day program management for one to two development programs, keeping schedules, responsibilities and risks visible across development and production departments. Working in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, you will build the habits and practice of program discipline that the whole company will adopt as the PMO scales. What you'll be doing Ownership and responsibility Own top level execution and delivery of assigned programs. Partner with project and discipline leads on cross-department programs to ensure execution on schedule and within budget. Manage the day-to-day execution of the assigned programs including handoffs across departments. Lead the program-management activities for your assigned programs: schedule build, baselining, gate reviews, etc. Manage uncertainty and risk Identify risks and bottlenecks early Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies Escalate risks and blockers to the relevant stakeholders promptly. Support growth and development of the team Mentor junior program managers in program execution and collaborative leadership. Support the PMO Lead in rolling out common language, product lifecycle, team rhythms for programs. Support general program management training across the organization. Your Profile Leadership experience Over 6 years of experience, including more than 4 years managing the delivery of complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a program management role. Lead programs coordinating across functions and departments. Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts. Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus. Approach Learn quickly in a highly technical, low-maturity field, without needing a deep technical background in quantum computing on day one. Translate a long-term strategy into an execution plan for your program teams. Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty. Bring together world-class technical experts and project leads to execute on highly complex programs. Technical Background MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field. Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus. Communication Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating program management ideas to highly technical people. Collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues across the organization - Product, Research and Development, Operations, Management team, etc. Communicate fluently in English. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening. Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.

We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.

But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

What will you be doing?

  • Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market;

  • Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

  • Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

  • Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

  • Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

What we are looking for

  • Fluent in Danish both written and spoken, as if it were your first language;

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

  • Final Interview - 30 mins - IRL/Virtual

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Sturing en beheersing Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten. Verandering en verbetering Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten; Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur. Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk; Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology. Wat vragen we van jou? Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren. Dit breng je minimaal mee: WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management; Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen; Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving; Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams; Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert; Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. raw.description:
Leid complexe verduurzamingsprojecten en bouw mee aan de toekomst van slimme verlichting. Als Senior Projectleider LED-verlichting bij Lumeco combineer je technische expertise, leiderschap en commercieel inzicht om projecten, klanten en collega’s naar een hoger niveau te brengen.

Wat ga je doen

  • Eindverantwoordelijk zijn voor complexe en grootschalige LED-verlichtingsprojecten

  • Leidinggeven aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd

  • Coachen en begeleiden van projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders en projectteams

  • Adviseren van klanten over innovatieve en duurzame verlichtingsoplossingen

  • Beoordelen van complexe technische vraagstukken en calculaties

  • Signaleren en benutten van commerciële kansen

  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van duurzame klantrelaties

  • Bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid, planning, budget en projectresultaten

  • Initiëren en implementeren van procesverbeteringen

  • Fungeren als technisch en organisatorisch aanspreekpunt binnen de organisatie

Wat wij je bieden

  • Je ontvangt een passend salaris, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, werkervaring en opleiding

  • 8% vakantiegeld

  • Winstdelingsregeling

  • Auto van de zaak

  • Laptop en mobiele telefoon

  • 25 vakantiedagen

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen met opleidingen, trainingen en cursussen

  • Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ondernemerschap

  • Een moderne en professionele werkomgeving

  • Maandelijkse werkborrels en meerdere bedrijfsuitjes per jaar

  • Mooie personeelskortingen bij bekende winkels en gerenommeerde merken

Wat neem je mee

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau

  • Ruime ervaring als projectleider binnen de installatietechniek, elektrotechniek of verlichtingsbranche

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe technische projecten

  • Uitgebreide kennis van elektrotechnische installaties

  • Ervaring met het aansturen en coachen van collega's

  • Sterke communicatieve en organisatorische vaardigheden

  • Commercieel inzicht en ondernemerschap

  • Het vermogen om meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk te managen

  • Een resultaatgerichte en proactieve werkhouding

  • Kennis van veiligheid, kwaliteit en projectbeheersing

Lumeco en de VDK Groep

Lumeco uit Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht is met circa 65 collega’s dé specialist in innovatieve en duurzame verlichtingsoplossingen. Vanuit één organisatie verzorgen wij advies, ontwerp, levering, installatie en onderhoud van LED-verlichting voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers door heel Nederland.

Wat Lumeco onderscheidt

  • Specialistische kennis van duurzame LED-verlichting en energiebesparing

  • Innovatieve verlichtingsoplossingen en eigen productontwikkelingen

  • Een compleet traject van advies en engineering tot installatie en onderhoud

Lumeco is onderdeel van de VDK Groep, een organisatie met meer dan 110 zelfstandige installatiebedrijven in Nederland. Dat betekent voor jou:

  • Zekerheid van werk en continuïteit

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen meerdere bedrijven

  • Toegang tot kennis, opleidingen en specialismen binnen de groep

Je werkt binnen een innovatieve specialist waar nieuwe ideeën worden gewaardeerd, terwijl je kunt bouwen op de kracht en stabiliteit van VDK Groep.
